_about: Round 38 (Robert: 'build rune craft and talisman into mid-tier game'). Two crafts nobody is born knowing. Rune craft is taught on floor 17 and talisman craft on floor 22, by people the deep has hidden (data/hidden_masters.json: rune_carver, talisman_scribe). RUNES are carved, then inscribed into what you wear. A weapon takes 1 rune, 2 at Runecraft 8, 3 at 15. Any other piece takes 1, 2 at Runecraft 12. Runes on worn pieces pool together, and each extra one of the same kind counts for less. Runes set in the right order on one piece speak a RUNE WORD. TALISMANS are drawn on spirit paper and burned (key 4, switch with 5): fire, frost, thunder, binding, iron skin, swiftness, mending, clear sight. Items, recipes and the two skills live here (Game merges them at start). Words: Dev's, brief 'runes' (data/drafts/runes.json).

runecraft.name: Runecraft
runecraft.desc: Carving the old marks into stone and setting them into steel. A rune holds an intent, and a weapon remembers it.

talismans.name: Talisman craft
talismans.desc: Brush, ink and qi on spirit paper. A talisman is a technique folded small enough to carry.

edge_rune.name: Rune of the Edge
edge_rune.desc: A single straight cut. Steel that carries it remembers it was made to cut.

ember_rune.name: Rune of the Ember
ember_rune.desc: A mark like a coal's crack. Warm to hold.

root_rune.name: Rune of the Root
root_rune.desc: A mark that branches downward. It drinks.

tide_rune.name: Rune of the Tide
tide_rune.desc: Two curves, one returning. It never stops moving.

stone_rune.name: Rune of the Stone
stone_rune.desc: A square inside a square. Heavy to carry, hard to move.

fortune_rune.name: Rune of Fortune
fortune_rune.desc: A coin's mark with a hole in it. The deep gives a little more to whoever wears it.

wind_rune.name: Rune of the Wind
wind_rune.desc: Three strokes that never quite meet.

eye_rune.name: Rune of the Eye
eye_rune.desc: An open eye, carved shut at the corners. It sees the soft places.

storm_rune.name: Rune of the Storm
storm_rune.desc: A broken line. It stings the hand that carves it.

song_rune.name: Rune of the Song
song_rune.desc: Carved to a note, not a shape. It hums when your qi passes.

star_rune.name: Rune of the Fallen Star
star_rune.desc: Five points and a tail. Heavier than the stone it's cut in.

void_rune.name: Rune of the Void
void_rune.desc: Nothing carved in a circle. It's hard to look at for long.

blank.name: Rune Blank
blank.desc: A smooth disc of bone-set silver, ready for a mark.

words.name: Keen Flame
words.hint: Edge, then Ember, on a blade.

words.name: Gale Edge
words.hint: The wind first, and the cut it carries.

words.name: Rooted Oak
words.hint: Root into stone, on something you wear.

words.name: Stillwater
words.hint: The tide that meets a stone and stops.

words.name: Seer's Mark
words.hint: An eye for fortune, anywhere you carry it.

words.name: Thunderclap
words.hint: Storm, storm, and then the edge comes down.

words.name: Singing Blade
words.hint: Two songs with the wind between them.

words.name: Fallen Star
words.hint: The star falls, burns, and splits the sky.

spirit_paper.name: Spirit Paper
spirit_paper.desc: Pressed herb pulp and resin. It takes ink, and holds qi like a held breath.

cinnabar_ink.name: Cinnabar Ink
cinnabar_ink.desc: Red ink ground from ember root and bloodsap. A talisman written in anything else is only a drawing.

flame_talisman.name: Flame Talisman
flame_talisman.desc: Burn it and the air around you catches. Everything near you burns.

frost_talisman.name: Frost Talisman
frost_talisman.desc: A breath of the deep cold: what's near you is cut and slowed.

thunder_talisman.name: Thunder Talisman
thunder_talisman.desc: A clap of thunder in a held hand. It hits hard and close.

binding_talisman.name: Binding Talisman
binding_talisman.desc: Threads of qi that hold everything near you where it stands. The great hold for less time.

ironskin_talisman.name: Iron Skin Talisman
ironskin_talisman.desc: For twenty breaths, blows land on you like rain on a roof: 40% less damage taken.

swift_talisman.name: Swift Talisman
swift_talisman.desc: Half a minute of moving like the wind: faster feet and faster strikes.

mending_talisman.name: Mending Talisman
mending_talisman.desc: Burned against a wound, it closes it: a third of your health, at once.

clear_sight_talisman.name: Clear Sight Talisman
clear_sight_talisman.desc: The floor you stand on, shown whole: the map is yours, and you see further for five minutes.

heavenfire_talisman.name: Heavenfire Talisman
heavenfire_talisman.desc: Written on frozen vellum in ink that never thawed, so the fire has something to fight. It burns down the sky.

mirror_seal_talisman.name: Mirror Seal Talisman
mirror_seal_talisman.desc: A seal against what the mirror shows. Past the twenty-fifth floor nothing is mapped, and the deep doesn't let the unsealed through. It burns out passing the gate.
